question: What will be the percentage change in the CBOE Volatility Index (VIX) (^VIX on Yahoo Finance) from the close on 2026-08-06 to the close on 2026-08-17?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to 100 x (close on 2026-08-17 / close on 2026-08-06 - 1), using daily closes of ^VIX on Yahoo Finance. If there is no close on 2026-08-17, the last close before it is used.

# VIX (^VIX): research brief for the Aug 6 → Aug 17, 2026 change

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on Yahoo Finance ^VIX daily closes. I tried to fetch Yahoo pages directly, but the proxy refused the connection.
- 2026-08-06: VIX closed at **15.15**, down 4.17% from 15.81 the previous session. This matches the baseline your code computed. [YCharts](https://ycharts.com/indicators/vix_volatility_index)
- 2026-08-05: VIX fell 4.2% to 15.81. The S&P 500 fell 0.2% to 7,723.55. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/stock-market-news-aug-6-094500461.html)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question. The window runs from the Aug 6 close (15.15) to the Aug 17 close, which is 7 trading days after Aug 7. For the question to move 10%, VIX would need to close around 16.67 or 13.64.
- The question allows -100% to +50%. A +50% move would mean a close of about 22.7.
- Several search results were published after 2026-08-07. I ignored them and left them out of this brief.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-07 (pre-market): The July jobs report showed payrolls **falling by 23,000**, against an expected gain of about 80,000. June was revised to -20,000 and unemployment edged down to 4.1%. Markets read the weak data as lowering the chance of a Fed rate **hike**, and stocks rose. [The Business Journal](https://thebusinessjournal.com/stocks-rise-weak-jobs-report-fed-rate-outlook-august-2026/), [TheStreet](https://www.thestreet.com/stock-market-today/stock-market-today-dow-jones-sp-500-nasdaq-updates-aug-7-2026), [Yahoo live blog](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-friday-august-7-nasdaq-dow-sp-500-july-jobs-report-surprises-100009572.html)
- 2026-08-07: Stock futures were steady ahead of the jobs report. [IC Markets](https://ic.com/blog/friday-7th-august-2026-u-s-stock-futures-hold-steady-ahead-of-july-jobs-report/)
- Context: the policy debate is about whether the Fed **hikes**, not when it cuts. Inflation sensitivity is high and crude oil prices are a factor. [Newsquawk](https://www.newsquawk.com/headlines/preview-us-cpi-due-wednesday-12th-august-2026-at-1330bst0830edt)
- Early August: VIX fell from 15.81 to 15.15 over two sessions while the S&P 500 sat near record levels in the mid-7,700s. Implied volatility looks low to moderate.

## 4. Base rates
- Your code's empirical distribution of 8-trading-day moves (last 3 years, last year weighted double) gives these VIX levels:
  - p5: 11.28 (-25.5%)
  - p10: 12.34 (-18.6%)
  - p25: 13.64 (-9.9%)
  - p50: 15.21 (+0.4%)
  - p75: 16.61 (+9.6%)
  - p90: 18.57 (+22.6%)
  - p95: 19.80 (+30.7%)
- The distribution is right-skewed: VIX tends to spike up more sharply than it falls. At a starting level around 15, big downside moves are limited because VIX rarely goes much below about 12 to 13.
- On seasonality, a Barchart piece titled "Is the VIX Inexpensive Going into the Historically Volatile Fall in 2026?" argues VIX looks cheap ahead of the usually volatile fall season. I couldn't fetch it to confirm its date. [Barchart](https://www.barchart.com/story/news/3956689/is-the-vix-inexpensive-going-into-the-historically-volatile-fall-in-2026)

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on the VIX level for Aug 17, 2026.
- I couldn't get August or September VIX futures prices dated on or before Aug 7. These would show the term structure (whether futures sit above spot, which is the usual contango). [Barchart VIX futures](https://www.barchart.com/futures/quotes/VI*0)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-08-07: The market reaction to the weak jobs report through Friday's close. The report came out before the forecast deadline, but the close comes after it.
- 2026-08-12 (Wed), 08:30 ET: July CPI. This is the main scheduled risk, given that the market is pricing possible Fed hikes. [Newsquawk](https://www.newsquawk.com/headlines/preview-us-cpi-due-wednesday-12th-august-2026-at-1330bst0830edt)
- Around 2026-08-13 and 08-14: PPI and retail sales are typically released in this window. I haven't confirmed the exact dates.
- Mid-August: earnings season is winding down. The window also includes a weekend (Aug 15 to 16) right before the Aug 17 close. Weekend timing affects how VIX is calculated, and that effect usually pushes Friday closes a little lower.
- The monthly VIX expiration (around Aug 19) falls after the resolution date.
- Other risks: Fed officials' speeches, oil price moves and geopolitical headlines. I didn't find any specific scheduled catalysts beyond those listed.
